verdict.rationale: cfo.ai is an AI-powered financial planning service that ingests sensitive ledger, payroll and CRM data, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions model-training use of customer data, an opt-out control, or a no-training guarantee. The per-tool allow/ask/deny approval policy and person-scoped MCP sign-in are adjacent access controls, not training-data controls, so they earn no credit.
